bca_jr_collect_job_count_stats = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$
        value = modifier:job_$JOB$_add
    }
    export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
        trigger = free_jobs_of_type
        parameters = { job = $JOB$ }
        variable = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
        trigger = free_jobs_of_type
        parameters = { job = $JOB$ include_deprioritized_jobs = yes }
        variable = bca_jr_acc_all_free_job_count_$JOB$
    }
}


bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = {
            bca_jr_has_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$ = yes
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$
            value = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$
            value = value:bca_job_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$_per_worker
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_collect_country_totals }
                check_variable = { which = bca_jr_acc_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$ value > 0 }
            }
            owner = {
                add_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_total_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$
                    value = prev.bca_jr_acc_output_$JOB$_$RESOURCE$
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


bca_jr_collect_current_pop_group_stats = {
    optimize_memory
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_v_size
        value = value:bca_jr_num_pops_assigned_to_job|JOB|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_job|POP_GROUP|event_target:bca_jr_current_pop_group|
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_size value > 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
            value = bca_jr_v_size
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_v_capacity
            value = value:bca_jr_workforce_capacity_mult_$JOB$
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_v_productive
            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
        }
        multiply_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_v_productive
            value = value:bca_jr_output_efficiency_mult_$JOB$
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_assigned_workforce_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_v_size
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_v_capacity
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_v_productive
        }
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_v_productive
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_collect_country_totals }
                OR = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$ value > 0 }
                    check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_v_productive value > 0 }
                }
            }
            owner = {
                add_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_total_assigned_workforce_$JOB$
                    value = prev.bca_jr_v_size
                }
                add_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_total_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
                    value = prev.bca_jr_v_capacity
                }
                add_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_total_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$
                    value = prev.bca_jr_v_productive
                }
                add_variable = {
                    which = bca_jr_total_productive_workforce_$JOB$
                    value = prev.bca_jr_v_productive
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_size
    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_capacity
    clear_variable = bca_jr_v_productive
}

bca_jr_finalize_single_job_stats = {
    optimize_memory
    # Open jobs = total jobs - deprioritized jobs.
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    subtract_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_all_free_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    add_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    # Automated workforce is supplied by all jobs but capped by currently open jobs.
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    multiply_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
        value = modifier:job_$JOB$_automated_workforce_mult
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ value > bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$ }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
    }
    multiply_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        value = value:bca_jr_automated_output_efficiency
    }
    add_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            owner = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_collect_country_totals }
            OR = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$ value > 0 }
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_$JOB$ value > 0 }
            }
        }
        owner = {
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_job_count_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_free_job_count_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_free_job_count_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_productive_workforce_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_automated_productive_workforce_$JOB$
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_pop_capacity_limit_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    subtract_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_pop_capacity_limit_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_automated_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
    }
    set_variable = {
        which = bca_jr_acc_closable_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
        value = bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            owner = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_collect_country_totals }
            OR = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_total_job_count_$JOB$ value > 0 }
                check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_productive_workforce_$JOB$ value > 0 }
            }
        }
        owner = {
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_pop_capacity_limit_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_pop_capacity_limit_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_open_job_count_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_open_job_count_$JOB$
            }
            add_variable = {
                which = bca_jr_total_closable_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
                value = prev.bca_jr_acc_closable_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_variable_set = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
            check_variable_arithmetic = { which = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_$JOB$ value > 0 }
            is_variable_set = bca_jr_acc_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_acc_pop_productive_workforce_$JOB$
        }
        divide_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_$JOB$
            value = bca_jr_acc_capacity_workforce_$JOB$
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { which = bca_jr_acc_avg_output_efficiency_$JOB$ value = 1 }
    }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = energy }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = minerals }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = food }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = alloys }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = consumer_goods }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = trade }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = unity }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = physics_research }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = society_research }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = engineering_research }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = rare_crystals }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = volatile_motes }
    bca_jr_finalize_single_job_resource = { JOB = $JOB$ RESOURCE = exotic_gases }
}
